question: Why can no material wealth compare to the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Even that is implied insufficient as comparison
inference: Even an ocean full of jewels cannot equal the value of this teaching.
uncertainties: The token akretuṃ is obscure and may be corrupt or compressed.
plain_english: Even if one possessed an ocean filled with jewels, such an accumulation would not suffice.
